Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows right lung hypoplasia with a characteristic curved opacity along the right heart border (the "Scimitar sign," indicated by the red arrow), which represents an anomalous pulmonary venous return. This finding, often associated with dextroposition of the heart and right upper lobe anomalies as seen in the CT scans (Figures 4 and 5), is diagnostic for Scimitar syndrome.
